title: Delete directory and contents
summary: Permanently removes a directory and all files and subdirectories inside it. This is a powerful command that deletes everything within the specified path.

steps.explain: Recursively removes the specified directory and all its contents. Be extremely careful with the path.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY_PATHS
placeholders.description: One or more paths to the directories you want to delete.

warnings: This command deletes all files and subdirectories inside the target directory.
Deleted data is not moved to the Trash and cannot be easily recovered.
Double-check the path to avoid deleting important system or user files.

rollback.explain: There is no built-in command to undo recursive deletion. You must restore from a backup if available.
